description: Recorded Claude Code 2.1.329 behavior (claude -p --output-format stream-json, isolated settings, 2026-11-20): a Stop mcp_tool hook whose tool answered after 45 s, with timeout 90, did not time out, and the stream carried a progress heartbeat (tool_progress, heartbeat: true) at 30 s while it ran (2.1.323). The run then completed normally. This is why a headless final Stop may hold the inbox open for 60 s, and why the plugin's Stop hook timeout (100 s) is above that wait plus both step budgets.
